description: Update a fulfillment vendor (partial — provide only the fields to change; the rest are preserved, including the saved template). Use status "paused"/"active" to pause or resume order emails.

include_shipping.description: Fill {{shipping_address}} with the customer ship-to (default true)

notes.description: Standing instructions sent with every order via {{vendor.notes}}

status.description: paused = new orders are skipped (recorded on the order) until resumed

template_html.description: Custom order-sheet HTML (max 50KB). Empty = the standard sheet. Custom HTML MUST contain {{items_table}} or an {{#items}}…{{/items}} block or the API returns NO_ITEMS_PLACEHOLDER. There are NO price tags.

name: update_vendor
